button.label: Remove Pictures
button.supertip: Deletes the pictures embedded in the body of the selected emails (logos, screenshots, signatures) to save mailbox space. Regular attachments are kept. Cannot be undone.

button.label: Remove Attachments
button.supertip: Removes the attached files from the selected emails to save mailbox space. First asks whether to save copies to a folder you choose. Adds a note at the top of each email listing what was removed. Pictures in the body are kept. Cannot be undone.

menu.label: More
menu.supertip: Shows how long each email will be kept, in a 'Retention' column you can sort by. These commands only READ each email's existing retention policy and display it. They never change a policy, delete anything, or keep anything longer.

button.label: Fill In This Folder
button.description: Fill the Retention column for the newest 6,000 emails in the folder you're viewing.
button.supertip: Reads the retention policy already on each email in the folder you're viewing (newest 6,000) and writes it into the Retention column, e.g. '6 Mos' or '3 Yrs'. Does not change any policy. Run again to do the next 6,000.

button.label: Fill In Whole Mailbox (6,000)
button.description: Same, across every folder in this mailbox, up to 6,000 emails per run.
button.supertip: Same as 'Fill In This Folder', but goes through every folder in the mailbox you're viewing, stopping after 6,000 emails. Does not change any policy.

button.label: Fill In Whole Mailbox (choose amount)
button.description: Same, but you choose how many emails to do in one run.
button.supertip: Same as above, but asks how many emails to do in one run. Larger numbers take longer and slow Outlook while running.

button.label: Add Retention Column Field
button.description: One-time: makes 'Retention' available as a column in every mail folder.
button.supertip: One-time setup per mailbox: adds 'Retention' to the list of columns you can show in every mail folder. Does not change any email.

button.label: Copy My View to All Folders
button.description: One-time: copies the column layout you're looking at now to every mail folder.
button.supertip: One-time setup: takes the column layout of the folder you're viewing (for example, with the Retention column added) and applies it to every mail folder in this mailbox, as a view named 'Retention View'. Does not change any email.
